IRVINE, Calif., July 26, 2017 /[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/)/ --With more than 350 new cars to choose from each year, the biggest challenge for consumers lies in sifting through all of them to find the most exceptional vehicle to fulfill their individual wants and needs.To provide shoppers with short lists they can use to start their new-car research with confidence, the editors at Kelley Blue Book [www.kbb.com](http://www.kbb.com/), have named the [10 Most Awarded Cars of 2017](https://www.kbb.com/car-reviews-and-news/top-10/most-awarded-cars-2017/2100004417/) and the [10 Most Awarded Brands of 2017](https://www.kbb.com/car-news/all-the-latest/most-awarded-brands-2017/2100004442/).

![Image 5](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/539244/Kelley_Blue_Book_10_Best_KBB_dot_Com_2017.jpg)

Kelley Blue Book's experts sorted through the winners from the brand's 2017 awards programs, to compile these two lists of the vehicles and brands that were recognized most often by Kelley Blue Book this year. KBB.com's major awards programs include the Best Buy Awards, Best Auto Tech Awards, Best Resale Value Awards, 5-Year Cost to Own Awards and Brand Image Awards. In addition, the various accolade car lists created by the KBB.com Editorial staff this year – including the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000, Best Family Cars, 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000 and many more – were also factored into the final tally.

"Kelley Blue Book's awards and accolades are some of the most well-regarded in the industry, primarily because they exist solely to help new-car shoppers make smart purchase decisions and to guide consumers in discovering which car best fits their lifestyle," said Jack R. Nerad, executive editorial director and executive market analyst for Kelley Blue Book's KBB.com. "Our expert editors drive and review nearly every new car on the road each year, so we have an abundance of knowledge that fuels our Top 10 lists and editorial awards, while our analysts evaluate tremendous amounts of data to help determine which vehicles make the cut for Kelley Blue Book's awards. Because of all the data and analysis that goes into them, they are a good place to start your new-car search."

Honda ran the table and achieved "The Blue Book Five" by winning at least one category in each of the site's major awards programs for 2017. Honda's feat is much like the sports and entertainment world's recognition of those who have secured victories in all major events – winning such titles as a tennis Grand Slam, the Triple Crown and the EGOT.This year, Honda vehicles were featured on Kelley Blue Book award and accolade lists more than 30 times.Other noteworthy automakers that topped KBB.com's list of Most Awarded Brands include Chevrolet, Subaru, Ford, and two luxury brands, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche.

**KBB.com's 10 Most Awarded Cars of 2017**

**Rank****Year****Make****Model****Sample Editorial Comments**
1 2017 Honda Accord The Accord earned the most accolades for 2017, and the variety of other awards it won call out the sedan's strong suits: it's a 5-Year Cost to Own standout, one of the 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000, and it's one of our Best Family Sedans.
2 2017 Honda Civic The Civic has been our Small Car Best Buy winner every year since the award's inception, and repeated as the Overall Best Buy for 2017. It's also lauded for its tech features, as one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000, and for its status as an appealing family sedan.
3 2017 Jeep Wrangler The Wrangler's soft-top and trail-ready nature made it a shoo-in for the 10 Most Fun SUVs as well as one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $25,000. But it also appeals to the practical side, earning two Best Resale Value awards as well as a spot on the 5-Year Cost to Own Award list.
4 2017 Hyundai Sonata The Sonata is a compelling alternative to popular choices like the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry. In 2017, this past Best Buy Award winner earned praise as one of the 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000 and one of the 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000.
5 2017 Kia Optima The sporty, stylish sedan was named one of our 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000 and one of our Best Family Sedans. The Optima's hybrid variants were also recognized, as both the Hybrid and the Plug-in Hybrid were among the best hybrids under $40,000.
6 2017 Toyota Prius/Prius Prime Toyota's newest-generation hybrid (Prius) and plug-in hybrid (Prius Prime) have been named as the Best Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid Cars Under $40,000, and earned 5-Year Cost to Own Awards. The Prius Prime is also a 2017 Best Buy Award winner.
7 2017 Chevrolet Impala The Impala is a three-time Best Buy award winner, one of this year's Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000, one of our Best Family Sedans and offers impressive 5-Year Cost to Own numbers.
8 2017 Kia Sportage The Sportage is this year's Small SUV Best Buy for many reasons, including value, practicality, style and an excellent warranty. These aspects of the Sportage also earned it a spot on our 12 Best Family Cars list, and made it one of the 10 Best SUVs Under $25,000.
9 2017 Honda CR-V The CR-V is a frequent award-winner and now has even more accolades for its collection, including being chosen as one of KBB's 12 Best Family Cars, one of our 10 Best SUVs Under $25,000 and one of the 10 Best All-Wheel-Drive Vehicles Under $25,000.
10 2017 Subaru Impreza This year, the Impreza is one of the 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000, a Best Resale Value Award winner and was named one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000.

IRVINE, Calif., July 26, 2017 /[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/)/ --With more than 350 new cars to choose from each year, the biggest challenge for consumers lies in sifting through all of them to find the most exceptional vehicle to fulfill their individual wants and needs.To provide shoppers with short lists they can use to start their new-car research with confidence, the editors at Kelley Blue Book [www.kbb.com](http://www.kbb.com/), have named the [10 Most Awarded Cars of 2017](https://www.kbb.com/car-reviews-and-news/top-10/most-awarded-cars-2017/2100004417/) and the [10 Most Awarded Brands of 2017](https://www.kbb.com/car-news/all-the-latest/most-awarded-brands-2017/2100004442/).

![Image 5](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/539244/Kelley_Blue_Book_10_Best_KBB_dot_Com_2017.jpg)

Kelley Blue Book's experts sorted through the winners from the brand's 2017 awards programs, to compile these two lists of the vehicles and brands that were recognized most often by Kelley Blue Book this year. KBB.com's major awards programs include the Best Buy Awards, Best Auto Tech Awards, Best Resale Value Awards, 5-Year Cost to Own Awards and Brand Image Awards. In addition, the various accolade car lists created by the KBB.com Editorial staff this year – including the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000, Best Family Cars, 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000 and many more – were also factored into the final tally.

"Kelley Blue Book's awards and accolades are some of the most well-regarded in the industry, primarily because they exist solely to help new-car shoppers make smart purchase decisions and to guide consumers in discovering which car best fits their lifestyle," said Jack R. Nerad, executive editorial director and executive market analyst for Kelley Blue Book's KBB.com. "Our expert editors drive and review nearly every new car on the road each year, so we have an abundance of knowledge that fuels our Top 10 lists and editorial awards, while our analysts evaluate tremendous amounts of data to help determine which vehicles make the cut for Kelley Blue Book's awards. Because of all the data and analysis that goes into them, they are a good place to start your new-car search."

Honda ran the table and achieved "The Blue Book Five" by winning at least one category in each of the site's major awards programs for 2017. Honda's feat is much like the sports and entertainment world's recognition of those who have secured victories in all major events – winning such titles as a tennis Grand Slam, the Triple Crown and the EGOT.This year, Honda vehicles were featured on Kelley Blue Book award and accolade lists more than 30 times.Other noteworthy automakers that topped KBB.com's list of Most Awarded Brands include Chevrolet, Subaru, Ford, and two luxury brands, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche.

**KBB.com's 10 Most Awarded Cars of 2017**

**Rank****Year****Make****Model****Sample Editorial Comments**
1 2017 Honda Accord The Accord earned the most accolades for 2017, and the variety of other awards it won call out the sedan's strong suits: it's a 5-Year Cost to Own standout, one of the 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000, and it's one of our Best Family Sedans.
2 2017 Honda Civic The Civic has been our Small Car Best Buy winner every year since the award's inception, and repeated as the Overall Best Buy for 2017. It's also lauded for its tech features, as one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000, and for its status as an appealing family sedan.
3 2017 Jeep Wrangler The Wrangler's soft-top and trail-ready nature made it a shoo-in for the 10 Most Fun SUVs as well as one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $25,000. But it also appeals to the practical side, earning two Best Resale Value awards as well as a spot on the 5-Year Cost to Own Award list.
4 2017 Hyundai Sonata The Sonata is a compelling alternative to popular choices like the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry. In 2017, this past Best Buy Award winner earned praise as one of the 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000 and one of the 10 Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000.
5 2017 Kia Optima The sporty, stylish sedan was named one of our 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000 and one of our Best Family Sedans. The Optima's hybrid variants were also recognized, as both the Hybrid and the Plug-in Hybrid were among the best hybrids under $40,000.
6 2017 Toyota Prius/Prius Prime Toyota's newest-generation hybrid (Prius) and plug-in hybrid (Prius Prime) have been named as the Best Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid Cars Under $40,000, and earned 5-Year Cost to Own Awards. The Prius Prime is also a 2017 Best Buy Award winner.
7 2017 Chevrolet Impala The Impala is a three-time Best Buy award winner, one of this year's Most Comfortable Cars Under $30,000, one of our Best Family Sedans and offers impressive 5-Year Cost to Own numbers.
8 2017 Kia Sportage The Sportage is this year's Small SUV Best Buy for many reasons, including value, practicality, style and an excellent warranty. These aspects of the Sportage also earned it a spot on our 12 Best Family Cars list, and made it one of the 10 Best SUVs Under $25,000.
9 2017 Honda CR-V The CR-V is a frequent award-winner and now has even more accolades for its collection, including being chosen as one of KBB's 12 Best Family Cars, one of our 10 Best SUVs Under $25,000 and one of the 10 Best All-Wheel-Drive Vehicles Under $25,000.
10 2017 Subaru Impreza This year, the Impreza is one of the 10 Best Sedans Under $25,000, a Best Resale Value Award winner and was named one of the 10 Coolest Cars Under $18,000.

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2018

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/allyson-harwood.jpg?w=400&quality=75&strip=all)[Allyson Harwood](https://www.kbb.com/author/allysonharwood/ "Posts By Allyson Harwood")08/01/2018 6:00pm

There are some automotive brands that earn awards not just for one model, but for many vehicles throughout the company’s portfolio. Oftentimes, this lineup of SUVs, cars and trucks has a winning mix of comfort, reliability, resale value, capability, innovation and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2018.

[![Image 5](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/04-2017-Honda-Pilot-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/honda)

**#1****[Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda)**Honda’s extensive array of SUVs and cars, as well as its truck and minivan, have established a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability. In addition, the vehicles are filled with thoughtful touches and are fun to drive. The Accord, Fit, Civic, HR-V, Odyssey, Pilot, Clarity, CR-V, and Ridgeline all earned accolades this year — including seven Best Buy Awards — for an incredible 34 awards.

[![Image 7](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/02-2018-Toyota-Sienna-SE-Exterior-KBB-1.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)

**#2[Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)**Known for its family-friendly lineup, Toyota’s vehicles combine legendary reliability, a comfortable ride, easy-to-use interiors, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, highly efficient hybrids and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 28 titles in 2018.

[![Image 9](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-Chevrolet-Impala-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet)

**#3[Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**This year, Chevrolet earned recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers of its long-range electric car, full-size SUVs, and pickup trucks, plus SUVs that offer value and versatility, and comfortable sedans that are smart choices for families.

[![Image 11](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/03-2018-Audi-Q5-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/audi)

**#4[Audi](https://www.kbb.com/audi)**Audi’s well-balanced lineup of sporty sedans and SUVs offers excellent connectivity and tech, fun-to-drive attitude, and luxury with a healthy serving of value. The company’s Q3 and Q5 SUVs, plus many of Audi’s sedans earned accolades this year, including two Best Buy Awards.

![Image 13: http://www.kbb.com/subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-subaru-outback-FC-1.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)

**#5[Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)**Subaru’s all-wheel-drive cars and SUVs are built for four-season confidence. In addition, their vehicles are tops for value, as popular choices for the best AWD vehicles under $25,000, and also have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with Subaru’s commitment to practicality and safety, and driving enthusiasts can look to fun favorites like the WRX.

[![Image 15](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-Lexus-NX-200-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)

**#6 [Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)**Lexus has a well-rounded line of SUVs, sedans and sporty cars that are built to last. Eight 2018 models, including the GS sedan, and NX and RX SUVs, have received praise for strong resale value, low Cost to Own numbers, or both.

[![Image 17: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)

**#7 [Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)**Hyundai’s Sonata midsize sedan, the Elantra compact car, all-new Kona, subcompact Accent, and Santa Fe Sport and Tucson SUVs all received accolades this year thanks in large part to the value proposition on which the brand was built.

[![Image 19: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep)

**#8 [Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep)**Starting as one iconic model — which became the Wrangler — Jeep has expanded, now with several models to choose from. The Renegade is a cool smaller SUV that offers value-priced off-roading fun, and the Wrangler won its own share of awards both in two-and four-door form, thanks to strong resale value and low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers.

[![Image 21: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/ford)

**#9 [Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford)**Classic names like Mustang and F-Series have been around for decades, but Ford has embraced forward-thinking technology to keep both of them relevant and popular. The F-150 has now been the best-selling vehicle in the USA for more than 35 years and is a four-time Best Buy Award winner, while the Mustang Shelby GT350 boasts strong resale value and Cost to Own numbers. The all-new Expedition, and the Focus and Fusion also earned official Kelley Blue Book recognition this year.

[![Image 23: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)

**#10[Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)**Another iconic brand, Porsche has received awards for its Macan and Cayenne SUVs, Panamera four-door executive car, and Cayman and Boxster sports cars. Not only are Porsches a thrill to drive, but they excel when it comes to practical matters like resale value.

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2018

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/allyson-harwood.jpg?w=400&quality=75&strip=all)[Allyson Harwood](https://www.kbb.com/author/allysonharwood/ "Posts By Allyson Harwood")08/01/2018 6:00pm

There are some automotive brands that earn awards not just for one model, but for many vehicles throughout the company’s portfolio. Oftentimes, this lineup of SUVs, cars and trucks has a winning mix of comfort, reliability, resale value, capability, innovation and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2018.

[![Image 5](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/04-2017-Honda-Pilot-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/honda)

**#1****[Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda)**Honda’s extensive array of SUVs and cars, as well as its truck and minivan, have established a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability. In addition, the vehicles are filled with thoughtful touches and are fun to drive. The Accord, Fit, Civic, HR-V, Odyssey, Pilot, Clarity, CR-V, and Ridgeline all earned accolades this year — including seven Best Buy Awards — for an incredible 34 awards.

[![Image 7](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/02-2018-Toyota-Sienna-SE-Exterior-KBB-1.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)

**#2[Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)**Known for its family-friendly lineup, Toyota’s vehicles combine legendary reliability, a comfortable ride, easy-to-use interiors, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, highly efficient hybrids and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 28 titles in 2018.

[![Image 9](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-Chevrolet-Impala-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet)

**#3[Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**This year, Chevrolet earned recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers of its long-range electric car, full-size SUVs, and pickup trucks, plus SUVs that offer value and versatility, and comfortable sedans that are smart choices for families.

[![Image 11](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/03-2018-Audi-Q5-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/audi)

**#4[Audi](https://www.kbb.com/audi)**Audi’s well-balanced lineup of sporty sedans and SUVs offers excellent connectivity and tech, fun-to-drive attitude, and luxury with a healthy serving of value. The company’s Q3 and Q5 SUVs, plus many of Audi’s sedans earned accolades this year, including two Best Buy Awards.

![Image 13: http://www.kbb.com/subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-subaru-outback-FC-1.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)

**#5[Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)**Subaru’s all-wheel-drive cars and SUVs are built for four-season confidence. In addition, their vehicles are tops for value, as popular choices for the best AWD vehicles under $25,000, and also have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with Subaru’s commitment to practicality and safety, and driving enthusiasts can look to fun favorites like the WRX.

[![Image 15](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2018-Lexus-NX-200-Exterior-KBB.jpg?w=380&h=228&crop=1)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)

**#6 [Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)**Lexus has a well-rounded line of SUVs, sedans and sporty cars that are built to last. Eight 2018 models, including the GS sedan, and NX and RX SUVs, have received praise for strong resale value, low Cost to Own numbers, or both.

[![Image 17: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)

**#7 [Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)**Hyundai’s Sonata midsize sedan, the Elantra compact car, all-new Kona, subcompact Accent, and Santa Fe Sport and Tucson SUVs all received accolades this year thanks in large part to the value proposition on which the brand was built.

[![Image 19: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep)

**#8 [Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep)**Starting as one iconic model — which became the Wrangler — Jeep has expanded, now with several models to choose from. The Renegade is a cool smaller SUV that offers value-priced off-roading fun, and the Wrangler won its own share of awards both in two-and four-door form, thanks to strong resale value and low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers.

[![Image 21: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/ford)

**#9 [Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford)**Classic names like Mustang and F-Series have been around for decades, but Ford has embraced forward-thinking technology to keep both of them relevant and popular. The F-150 has now been the best-selling vehicle in the USA for more than 35 years and is a four-time Best Buy Award winner, while the Mustang Shelby GT350 boasts strong resale value and Cost to Own numbers. The all-new Expedition, and the Focus and Fusion also earned official Kelley Blue Book recognition this year.

[![Image 23: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)

**#10[Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)**Another iconic brand, Porsche has received awards for its Macan and Cayenne SUVs, Panamera four-door executive car, and Cayman and Boxster sports cars. Not only are Porsches a thrill to drive, but they excel when it comes to practical matters like resale value.

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2019

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/kbb-logo-blue2.png?w=714&quality=75&strip=all)[KBB Editors](https://www.kbb.com/author/kbbeditor/ "Posts By KBB Editors")07/18/2019 2:02am

Some automotive brands have such impressive portfolios that they earn awards not just for one model, but for several of them. The makes that come out on top boast solid lineups of SUVs, cars, minivans and trucks that deliver reliability, resale value, capability, comfort, innovation and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2019.

[![Image 5: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/honda/pilot/2019/best-buys-2019-resized/380x228-2019-honda-pilot-bb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda)

**#1****[Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda)**Having established a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability, Honda’s extensive array of SUVs and cars, as well as its truck and minivan, have earned this automaker the most accolades for 2019. Other strong attributes these vehicles offer are thoughtful touches, family-friendly features, and a fun-to-drive nature. The Fit, Accord, Civic, HR-V, Odyssey, Pilot, Clarity, CR-V, and Ridgeline all earned accolades this year — including six Best Buy Awards — for an incredible 31 awards.

[![Image 7: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/toyota/4runner/2018/380x228-2018-toyota-4runner.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)

**#2[Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)**Another brand that’s known for legendary reliability in a family-friendly lineup, Toyota makes vehicles that combine easy-to-use interiors, a comfortable ride, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, versatile SUVs, highly efficient hybrids and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 20 titles in 2019.

[![Image 9: ,http://www.kbb.com/subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/subaru/ascent/2019/2019-subaru-ascent-drive/380x228-2019-subaru-ascent.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)

**#3[Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)**For 2019, Subaru expanded its lineup to include a 3-row model, the Ascent. Subaru’s vehicles are known for all-season confidence and are tops for value. They are popular choices for the best AWD vehicles under $30,000, and also have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with the safety and practicality Subarus are known for while driving enthusiasts can look to fun favorites like the BRZ.

[![Image 11: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/hyundai/santa-fe/2019/kbb/380x228-2019-hyundai-santa-fe-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)

**#4[Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)**Hyundai’s all-new Santa Fe, subcompact Kona, Sonata midsize sedan, new-for-2019 Veloster, fuel-sipping Ioniq, and the compact Tucson SUV all received accolades this year thanks in large part to the value proposition on which the brand was built.

[![Image 13: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/lexus/es/2019/lexus-es-300h-kbb-best-buys/380x228-2019-lexus-es-300h-bb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)

**#5[Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)**Lexus has a well-rounded line of SUVs, sedans and sporty cars that are built to last. The excellent ES sedan and sporty RC were recognized in 2019, but the Lexus SUVs stole the show, with five different models including the RX receiving praise for strong resale value, low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers, or both.

[![Image 15: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/chevrolet/silverado-1500/2019/2019-silverado-kbb/380x228-2019-chevrolet-silverado-high-country-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet)

**#6[Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**Chevrolet cars, trucks, and SUVs earned recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers – and all three sizes of Chevy trucks won Best Resale Value Awards. The full-size Impala also received praise, as did the Equinox, Tahoe and Traverse, for a total of 12 accolades.

[![Image 17: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/ford)

**#7[Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford)**The Mustang and the F-Series have been around for decades, but Ford’s commitment to forward-thinking technology keep both vehicles relevant, popular modern-day classics. The F-150 has now been the best-selling vehicle in the USA for more than 35 years and is a 5-time Best Buy Award winner, while the Mustang Shelby GT350 boasts strong resale value and Cost to Own numbers. The Expedition and Fusion also earned official Kelley Blue Book recognition this year.

[![Image 19: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)

**#8[Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)**Speaking of iconic brands, Porsche has received awards for its Cayenne and Macan SUVs, and the Panamera 4-door executive car. Not only are Porsches a thrill to drive, but they excel when it comes to practical matters like resale value.

[![Image 21: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/kia)

**#9[Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia)**Kia offers a well-crafted blend of upscale features and value for the money. That combination can be seen in everything from the company’s Soul compact hatchback to the high-performance Stinger sports sedan. Five models earned accolades this year, including a 5-Year Cost to Own Award.

![Image 23: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

**#10 [Volkswagen](https://www.kbb.com/volkswagen)**Just because Volkswagens are practical doesn’t mean they can’t be fun, too. Consider the Atlas SUV and the Passat sedan, both of which are comfortable and spacious yet have the Euro-inspired handling that can make errand-running fun. These models earned praise in 2019, as did the Golf, GTI, Jetta and Golf Alltrack.

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2019

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/kbb-logo-blue2.png?w=714&quality=75&strip=all)[KBB Editors](https://www.kbb.com/author/kbbeditor/ "Posts By KBB Editors")07/18/2019 2:02am

Some automotive brands have such impressive portfolios that they earn awards not just for one model, but for several of them. The makes that come out on top boast solid lineups of SUVs, cars, minivans and trucks that deliver reliability, resale value, capability, comfort, innovation and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2019.

[![Image 5: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/honda/pilot/2019/best-buys-2019-resized/380x228-2019-honda-pilot-bb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda)

**#1****[Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda)**Having established a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability, Honda’s extensive array of SUVs and cars, as well as its truck and minivan, have earned this automaker the most accolades for 2019. Other strong attributes these vehicles offer are thoughtful touches, family-friendly features, and a fun-to-drive nature. The Fit, Accord, Civic, HR-V, Odyssey, Pilot, Clarity, CR-V, and Ridgeline all earned accolades this year — including six Best Buy Awards — for an incredible 31 awards.

[![Image 7: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/toyota/4runner/2018/380x228-2018-toyota-4runner.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)

**#2[Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota)**Another brand that’s known for legendary reliability in a family-friendly lineup, Toyota makes vehicles that combine easy-to-use interiors, a comfortable ride, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, versatile SUVs, highly efficient hybrids and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 20 titles in 2019.

[![Image 9: ,http://www.kbb.com/subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/subaru/ascent/2019/2019-subaru-ascent-drive/380x228-2019-subaru-ascent.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)

**#3[Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru)**For 2019, Subaru expanded its lineup to include a 3-row model, the Ascent. Subaru’s vehicles are known for all-season confidence and are tops for value. They are popular choices for the best AWD vehicles under $30,000, and also have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with the safety and practicality Subarus are known for while driving enthusiasts can look to fun favorites like the BRZ.

[![Image 11: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/hyundai/santa-fe/2019/kbb/380x228-2019-hyundai-santa-fe-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)

**#4[Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai)**Hyundai’s all-new Santa Fe, subcompact Kona, Sonata midsize sedan, new-for-2019 Veloster, fuel-sipping Ioniq, and the compact Tucson SUV all received accolades this year thanks in large part to the value proposition on which the brand was built.

[![Image 13: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/lexus/es/2019/lexus-es-300h-kbb-best-buys/380x228-2019-lexus-es-300h-bb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)

**#5[Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus)**Lexus has a well-rounded line of SUVs, sedans and sporty cars that are built to last. The excellent ES sedan and sporty RC were recognized in 2019, but the Lexus SUVs stole the show, with five different models including the RX receiving praise for strong resale value, low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers, or both.

[![Image 15: ,](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/make/chevrolet/silverado-1500/2019/2019-silverado-kbb/380x228-2019-chevrolet-silverado-high-country-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet)

**#6[Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**Chevrolet cars, trucks, and SUVs earned recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers – and all three sizes of Chevy trucks won Best Resale Value Awards. The full-size Impala also received praise, as did the Equinox, Tahoe and Traverse, for a total of 12 accolades.

[![Image 17: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/ford)

**#7[Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford)**The Mustang and the F-Series have been around for decades, but Ford’s commitment to forward-thinking technology keep both vehicles relevant, popular modern-day classics. The F-150 has now been the best-selling vehicle in the USA for more than 35 years and is a 5-time Best Buy Award winner, while the Mustang Shelby GT350 boasts strong resale value and Cost to Own numbers. The Expedition and Fusion also earned official Kelley Blue Book recognition this year.

[![Image 19: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)

**#8[Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche)**Speaking of iconic brands, Porsche has received awards for its Cayenne and Macan SUVs, and the Panamera 4-door executive car. Not only are Porsches a thrill to drive, but they excel when it comes to practical matters like resale value.

[![Image 21: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)](https://www.kbb.com/kia)

**#9[Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia)**Kia offers a well-crafted blend of upscale features and value for the money. That combination can be seen in everything from the company’s Soul compact hatchback to the high-performance Stinger sports sedan. Five models earned accolades this year, including a 5-Year Cost to Own Award.

![Image 23: A close up of a Hyundai IONIQ 5 charging.](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2021

By![Image 3](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/f839942678ac0e320c8b6209f9f75ac823ffa64b361e2bbfa80bbea032b24deb?s=20&d=mm&r=g)[Nicole Wakelin](https://www.kbb.com/author/nicolewakelin/ "Posts By Nicole Wakelin")12/09/2021 4:00pm

While some brands have a car or two that earn awards, others have lineups full of award winners. They offer everything from family-friendly [SUVs](https://www.kbb.com/suv/) and [crossovers](https://www.kbb.com/suv/best-compact-suvs/) to sedans to capable [trucks](https://www.kbb.com/pickup-truck/) perfect for getting work done. These brands have a history of reliability, comfort, and resale value that consistently put them at the top of awards lists. Here are the 10 most awarded brands from Kelley Blue Book for 2021.

[![Image 5: 1. Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/2021-Toyota-Sienna-front-right-3qtr-4x3-1.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

### **[1. Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)**

Toyota has a solid reputation for building reliable vehicles. It offers a range of family-friendly options including affordable sedans, crossovers, and SUVs that all have quality interiors and comfortable rides. There are plenty of hybrids in the mix plus trucks for getting you through the workday. It also has impressive resale values that helped it earn 41 awards in 2021, including four Best Buy Awards and 10 Best Resale Value Awards.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

[![Image 7: 2. Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/2021-Hyundai-Elantra-front-right-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

### **[2. Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)**

Hyundai moves up a few spots to second place this year with a total of 22 awards. Its high-quality interiors combined with affordable pricing helped it earn numerous accolades. The Sonata and Elantra sedans received multiple awards, as did the Santa Fe SUV. There are even EVs and hybrids on the list with both the Kona Electric and Ioniq earning recognition.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

[![Image 9: 3. Ford](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/2021-ford-mustang-mach-e-front-right-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

### **[3. Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)**

Ford has a strong lineup that includes the best-selling F-150, which is a 7-time Best Buy Award winner. It also received a 5-Year Cost to Own award. Plenty of new vehicles received awards, too, with the Mustang Mach-E named one of the 14 Best New and Redesigned SUVs for 2021. The Bronco also earned recognition as one of the 10 Most Fun SUVs of 2021, helping Ford earn 18 awards in total.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

[![Image 11: 4. Kia](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/2021-kia-telluride-4wd-front-right-side-e1619632531364.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

### **[4. Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)**

Kia made the list with a total of 17 awards. The 3-row Telluride earned five of those awards, including a Best Buy Award, 12 Best Family Cars of 2021, and Best Resale Value Award. Kia’s lineup of affordable vehicles earned the Soul and Forte spots on the 10 Coolest Cars Under $20,000 for 2021 list, while the Soul and Seltos were both named one of the 10 Best Family Cars Under $25,000.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

[![Image 13: 5. Honda](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/2021-honda-pilot-red-driving-front-3qtr-1-e1625173254665.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

### **[5. Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)**

Honda has a long history of producing reliable cars with great resale value, so it’s no surprise to see it on our list. It earned 15 awards this year in a variety of categories. The HR-V, Civic Hatchback, CR-V, Pilot, and Odyssey all earned recognition as Best Family Cars. And the Accord was a Best Buy Award winner in 2021, its sixth time being named Best Midsize Car.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

[![Image 15: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

### **[6. Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)**

Known for being a more rugged option that’s ideal for those who have active lifestyles, Subaru is strong on reliability and resale value. The Impreza, Crosstrek, Forester, and Outback all received a Best Resale Value award. The Forester, Outback, and 3-row Ascent received 5-Year Cost to Own awards. The upcoming Solterra electric SUV even made an appearance as one of the 10 Best SUVs Worth Waiting For and is due to go on sale in 2022.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

[![Image 17: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

### **[7. Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)**

Off-road fans will be happy to hear Jeep made our list with 11 awards this year. The Jeep Wrangler and Gladiator won three Best Resale Value Awards. The Wrangler went on to win a 5-Year Cost to Own Award and was named one of the 10 Most Fun SUVs of 2021. And the new 3-row Grand Cherokee L was found road-trip worthy with two awards.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

[![Image 19: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

### **[8. Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)**

Lexus is the only luxury brand that makes our list, coming in with 10 awards overall. Whether it’s a sedan or an SUV, expect a beautiful interior with a smooth, quiet ride and a responsive engine. Known for being reliable, Lexus earned three 5-Year Cost to Own Awards for the UX, NX, and RX, along with one for the brand overall. It also earned two Best Resale Value Awards for its IS and LS sedans, and the ES was a Best Buy winner.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

[![Image 21: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)

### **[9. Mazda](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)**

Mazda is new to this year’s list, also with 10 awards overall. Although not technically a luxury brand, Mazda pushes luxury territory with quiet interiors adorned with rich materials. Its cars also put the focus on the driver, making them exceptionally fun to drive, which helped it win five awards simply for being some of the coolest cars you can buy. The MX-5 Miata unsurprisingly received four awards, the most of any of its vehicles.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)

[![Image 23: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)

### **[10. Nissan](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)**

Also new to our list this year is Nissan, which earned nine awards overall. The Nissan lineup features everything from sports cars to sedans to SUVs and trucks with good features and affordable pricing. The Sentra and Altima sedans both earned awards, along with both the Rogue and Rogue Sport. Looking toward the future, the upcoming Ariya electric vehicle was recognized for being one of the 10 Best SUVs Worth Waiting For and is slated to be out by fall of 2022.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2021

By![Image 3](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/f839942678ac0e320c8b6209f9f75ac823ffa64b361e2bbfa80bbea032b24deb?s=20&d=mm&r=g)[Nicole Wakelin](https://www.kbb.com/author/nicolewakelin/ "Posts By Nicole Wakelin")12/09/2021 4:00pm

While some brands have a car or two that earn awards, others have lineups full of award winners. They offer everything from family-friendly [SUVs](https://www.kbb.com/suv/) and [crossovers](https://www.kbb.com/suv/best-compact-suvs/) to sedans to capable [trucks](https://www.kbb.com/pickup-truck/) perfect for getting work done. These brands have a history of reliability, comfort, and resale value that consistently put them at the top of awards lists. Here are the 10 most awarded brands from Kelley Blue Book for 2021.

[![Image 5: 1. Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/2021-Toyota-Sienna-front-right-3qtr-4x3-1.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

### **[1. Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)**

Toyota has a solid reputation for building reliable vehicles. It offers a range of family-friendly options including affordable sedans, crossovers, and SUVs that all have quality interiors and comfortable rides. There are plenty of hybrids in the mix plus trucks for getting you through the workday. It also has impressive resale values that helped it earn 41 awards in 2021, including four Best Buy Awards and 10 Best Resale Value Awards.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

[![Image 7: 2. Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/2021-Hyundai-Elantra-front-right-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

### **[2. Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)**

Hyundai moves up a few spots to second place this year with a total of 22 awards. Its high-quality interiors combined with affordable pricing helped it earn numerous accolades. The Sonata and Elantra sedans received multiple awards, as did the Santa Fe SUV. There are even EVs and hybrids on the list with both the Kona Electric and Ioniq earning recognition.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

[![Image 9: 3. Ford](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/2021-ford-mustang-mach-e-front-right-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

### **[3. Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)**

Ford has a strong lineup that includes the best-selling F-150, which is a 7-time Best Buy Award winner. It also received a 5-Year Cost to Own award. Plenty of new vehicles received awards, too, with the Mustang Mach-E named one of the 14 Best New and Redesigned SUVs for 2021. The Bronco also earned recognition as one of the 10 Most Fun SUVs of 2021, helping Ford earn 18 awards in total.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

[![Image 11: 4. Kia](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/2021-kia-telluride-4wd-front-right-side-e1619632531364.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

### **[4. Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)**

Kia made the list with a total of 17 awards. The 3-row Telluride earned five of those awards, including a Best Buy Award, 12 Best Family Cars of 2021, and Best Resale Value Award. Kia’s lineup of affordable vehicles earned the Soul and Forte spots on the 10 Coolest Cars Under $20,000 for 2021 list, while the Soul and Seltos were both named one of the 10 Best Family Cars Under $25,000.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

[![Image 13: 5. Honda](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/2021-honda-pilot-red-driving-front-3qtr-1-e1625173254665.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

### **[5. Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)**

Honda has a long history of producing reliable cars with great resale value, so it’s no surprise to see it on our list. It earned 15 awards this year in a variety of categories. The HR-V, Civic Hatchback, CR-V, Pilot, and Odyssey all earned recognition as Best Family Cars. And the Accord was a Best Buy Award winner in 2021, its sixth time being named Best Midsize Car.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

[![Image 15: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

### **[6. Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)**

Known for being a more rugged option that’s ideal for those who have active lifestyles, Subaru is strong on reliability and resale value. The Impreza, Crosstrek, Forester, and Outback all received a Best Resale Value award. The Forester, Outback, and 3-row Ascent received 5-Year Cost to Own awards. The upcoming Solterra electric SUV even made an appearance as one of the 10 Best SUVs Worth Waiting For and is due to go on sale in 2022.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

[![Image 17: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

### **[7. Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)**

Off-road fans will be happy to hear Jeep made our list with 11 awards this year. The Jeep Wrangler and Gladiator won three Best Resale Value Awards. The Wrangler went on to win a 5-Year Cost to Own Award and was named one of the 10 Most Fun SUVs of 2021. And the new 3-row Grand Cherokee L was found road-trip worthy with two awards.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

[![Image 19: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

### **[8. Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)**

Lexus is the only luxury brand that makes our list, coming in with 10 awards overall. Whether it’s a sedan or an SUV, expect a beautiful interior with a smooth, quiet ride and a responsive engine. Known for being reliable, Lexus earned three 5-Year Cost to Own Awards for the UX, NX, and RX, along with one for the brand overall. It also earned two Best Resale Value Awards for its IS and LS sedans, and the ES was a Best Buy winner.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

[![Image 21: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)

### **[9. Mazda](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)**

Mazda is new to this year’s list, also with 10 awards overall. Although not technically a luxury brand, Mazda pushes luxury territory with quiet interiors adorned with rich materials. Its cars also put the focus on the driver, making them exceptionally fun to drive, which helped it win five awards simply for being some of the coolest cars you can buy. The MX-5 Miata unsurprisingly received four awards, the most of any of its vehicles.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/mazda/)

[![Image 23: 10. Nissan](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)

### **[10. Nissan](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)**

Also new to our list this year is Nissan, which earned nine awards overall. The Nissan lineup features everything from sports cars to sedans to SUVs and trucks with good features and affordable pricing. The Sentra and Altima sedans both earned awards, along with both the Rogue and Rogue Sport. Looking toward the future, the upcoming Ariya electric vehicle was recognized for being one of the 10 Best SUVs Worth Waiting For and is slated to be out by fall of 2022.[Read more >>](https://www.kbb.com/nissan/)

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2020

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/allyson-harwood.jpg?w=400&quality=75&strip=all)[Allyson Harwood](https://www.kbb.com/author/allysonharwood/ "Posts By Allyson Harwood")08/26/2020 1:04pm

There are a few automotive brands that have such impressive portfolios that they earn awards not just for one model, but for several of them. The brands that rise to the top have solid lineups of SUVs, cars, minivans, and trucks that deliver value, reliability, innovation, strong resale numbers, capability, comfort, and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2020.

[![Image 5: #1 Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/2020-toyota-highlander-hybrid-driving-front-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

### **[#1 Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)**

Toyota has a legendary reputation for reliability and durability. It offers family-friendly vehicles that combine easy-to-use interiors, a comfortable ride, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, versatile SUVs, highly efficient hybrids, and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 23 accolades in 2020.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

[![Image 7: #2 Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2019-Subaru-Forester-Exterior-KBB-2.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

### **[#2 Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)**

Subaru has introduced four impressive all-new models within about a year. Their vehicles continue to be known for all-season confidence and are tops for value. Several models earned accolades as the best AWD vehicles under $30,000, and have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with the safety and practicality Subarus are known for.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

[![Image 9: #3 Honda](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/1a-2020-Honda-CR-V-Hybrid-oem.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

### **[#3 Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)**

Another company that has a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability is Honda. Honda’s well-rounded array of vehicles have thoughtful touches, family-friendly features, and are fun to drive. The CR-V, HR-V, Pilot, Accord, Civic, Odyssey, and Clarity all earned accolades this year — including five Best Buy Awards — for a total of 17.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

[![Image 11: #4 Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/01-2020-hyundai-santa-fe-bb-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

### **[#4 Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)**

Hyundai is known for offering a lot of features for the money. That value proposition is a big reason why Hyundai earned so many awards this year. The company earned three Best Buy Awards for the Santa Fe, subcompact Kona, and Kona Electric. It also netted three 5-Year Cost to Own awards, and three models earned best family car kudos. In all, nine different models received awards.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

[![Image 13: #5 Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/01-2019-chevrolet-silverado-high-country-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)

### **[#5 Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**

This year, Chevrolet cars, trucks, and SUVs received recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Three sizes of Chevy trucks won awards, including a Best Buy Award, two Best Resale Value Awards, and one 5-Year Cost to Own award. The all-new Corvette also received praise, as did the Tahoe and Impala, for a total of 12 accolades.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)

[![Image 15: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

### **[#6 Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)**

Ford has embraced forward-thinking technology, which has kept iconic vehicles like the Mustang and the F-Series relevant in a constantly changing market. The best-selling F-150 is a 6-time Best Buy Award winner. The Expedition is also a Best Buy Award winner in 2020, as well as one of our 12 Best Family Cars. The Ranger and the F-150 both boast strong resale value, too.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

[![Image 17: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

### **[#7 Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)**

From its sedans to its SUVs, Lexus’ well-rounded line vehicle range is built to last. The excellent ES and GS sedan were recognized in 2020, but the Lexus SUVs stole the show, with five different models including the RX receiving praise for strong resale value, low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers, or both.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

[![Image 19: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

### **[#8 Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)**

In 2020, Kia expanded its product line to include the all-new 3-row midsize Telluride SUV, which won two Best Buy Awards. It was also one of our 12 Best Family Cars. Kia offers a well-crafted blend of upscale features and value for the money. Six models earned accolades this year.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

[![Image 21: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

### **[#9 Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)**

Jeep won a lot of awards this year, thanks in no small part to the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own data for the Wrangler, in both 2- and 4-door form. Also on the list of award-winning vehicles are the new-for-2020 Gladiator truck, plus the Renegade and the Grand Cherokee.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

[![Image 23: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)

### **[#10 Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)**

Another iconic brand on this list, Porsche, has received awards for its Macan and Cayenne SUVs, as well as the 4-door Panamera sedan. Porsche proves that you can have a vehicle that’s thrilling to drive without sacrificing practical matters like resale value. [Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)

# Our 10 Most Awarded Brands of 2020

By![Image 3](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/allyson-harwood.jpg?w=400&quality=75&strip=all)[Allyson Harwood](https://www.kbb.com/author/allysonharwood/ "Posts By Allyson Harwood")08/26/2020 1:04pm

There are a few automotive brands that have such impressive portfolios that they earn awards not just for one model, but for several of them. The brands that rise to the top have solid lineups of SUVs, cars, minivans, and trucks that deliver value, reliability, innovation, strong resale numbers, capability, comfort, and fun. Here are the 10 brands that have earned the most accolades and awards from Kelley Blue Book for 2020.

[![Image 5: #1 Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/2020-toyota-highlander-hybrid-driving-front-3qtr.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

### **[#1 Toyota](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)**

Toyota has a legendary reputation for reliability and durability. It offers family-friendly vehicles that combine easy-to-use interiors, a comfortable ride, and top-notch value. Tough trucks, versatile SUVs, highly efficient hybrids, and excellent cars with strong 5-Year Cost to Own data and enviable resale values are a big part of why Toyota received 23 accolades in 2020.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/toyota/)

[![Image 7: #2 Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/01-2019-Subaru-Forester-Exterior-KBB-2.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

### **[#2 Subaru](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)**

Subaru has introduced four impressive all-new models within about a year. Their vehicles continue to be known for all-season confidence and are tops for value. Several models earned accolades as the best AWD vehicles under $30,000, and have impressive resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Families will be happy with the safety and practicality Subarus are known for.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/subaru/)

[![Image 9: #3 Honda](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/1a-2020-Honda-CR-V-Hybrid-oem.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

### **[#3 Honda](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)**

Another company that has a decades-long reputation for strong resale value and reliability is Honda. Honda’s well-rounded array of vehicles have thoughtful touches, family-friendly features, and are fun to drive. The CR-V, HR-V, Pilot, Accord, Civic, Odyssey, and Clarity all earned accolades this year — including five Best Buy Awards — for a total of 17.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/honda/)

[![Image 11: #4 Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/01-2020-hyundai-santa-fe-bb-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

### **[#4 Hyundai](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)**

Hyundai is known for offering a lot of features for the money. That value proposition is a big reason why Hyundai earned so many awards this year. The company earned three Best Buy Awards for the Santa Fe, subcompact Kona, and Kona Electric. It also netted three 5-Year Cost to Own awards, and three models earned best family car kudos. In all, nine different models received awards.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/hyundai/)

[![Image 13: #5 Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/01-2019-chevrolet-silverado-high-country-kbb.jpg)](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)

### **[#5 Chevrolet](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)**

This year, Chevrolet cars, trucks, and SUVs received recognition for the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own numbers. Three sizes of Chevy trucks won awards, including a Best Buy Award, two Best Resale Value Awards, and one 5-Year Cost to Own award. The all-new Corvette also received praise, as did the Tahoe and Impala, for a total of 12 accolades.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/)

[![Image 15: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

### **[#6 Ford](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)**

Ford has embraced forward-thinking technology, which has kept iconic vehicles like the Mustang and the F-Series relevant in a constantly changing market. The best-selling F-150 is a 6-time Best Buy Award winner. The Expedition is also a Best Buy Award winner in 2020, as well as one of our 12 Best Family Cars. The Ranger and the F-150 both boast strong resale value, too.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/ford/)

[![Image 17: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

### **[#7 Lexus](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)**

From its sedans to its SUVs, Lexus’ well-rounded line vehicle range is built to last. The excellent ES and GS sedan were recognized in 2020, but the Lexus SUVs stole the show, with five different models including the RX receiving praise for strong resale value, low 5-Year Cost to Own numbers, or both.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/lexus/)

[![Image 19: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

### **[#8 Kia](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)**

In 2020, Kia expanded its product line to include the all-new 3-row midsize Telluride SUV, which won two Best Buy Awards. It was also one of our 12 Best Family Cars. Kia offers a well-crafted blend of upscale features and value for the money. Six models earned accolades this year.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/kia/)

[![Image 21: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

### **[#9 Jeep](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)**

Jeep won a lot of awards this year, thanks in no small part to the excellent resale value and 5-Year Cost to Own data for the Wrangler, in both 2- and 4-door form. Also on the list of award-winning vehicles are the new-for-2020 Gladiator truck, plus the Renegade and the Grand Cherokee.[Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/jeep/)

[![Image 23: #10 Porsche](blob:http://localhost/dc3deecc69ceff04d222d8a906bbfc10)](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)

### **[#10 Porsche](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)**

Another iconic brand on this list, Porsche, has received awards for its Macan and Cayenne SUVs, as well as the 4-door Panamera sedan. Porsche proves that you can have a vehicle that’s thrilling to drive without sacrificing practical matters like resale value. [Read More **»**](https://www.kbb.com/porsche/)
